title: Domain-aligned self-supervision: CT-specialized DINOv3 enhances PET/CT tumor segmentation
mechanism: Evidence study: domain proximity and pretraining scale jointly decide whether DINOv3 pretraining helps; natural-image DINOv3 can fail to beat random init on a distant greyscale modality.
evidence: R (abstract): frozen encoders in nnU-Net, 5-fold CV on autoPET and HECKTOR; CT-pretrained DINOv3 best; natural-image DINOv3 did not beat from-scratch.
adaptation: Caution for every natural-image VFM arm on EL, and support for in-domain continued pretraining on the EL pool (ExPLoRA / MedDINOv3) over more natural-image scale.
min_experiment: Covered by the ExPLoRA arm: adapted vs original backbone on E1 relF1@2; kill if not +0.02.
prior_overlap: Not a method run here; informs the A8 null.
